headline: Prabowo Subianto Discusses South China Sea With Xi Jinping
seoTitle: Prabowo Subianto and Xi Jinping Meet in Shenzhen
metaDescription: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto held a bilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen to discuss strategic cooperation and maritime.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto and President Xi Jinping held a bilateral meeting at Kylin Villa in Shenzhen.
The two leaders discussed strengthening strategic relations and cooperation regarding the South China Sea.
Xi Jinping noted that this marks the fourth meeting between the two heads of state within the last two years.
aiContextParagraph: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto traveled to Shenzhen, China, to conduct a high-level bilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The summit took place at the Kylin Villa on November 20, 2026. During the discussions, the leaders focused on reinforcing strategic partnerships between Indonesia and China across multiple sectors. A primary topic of the dialogue included cooperation concerning the South China Sea. According to remarks provided by the Chinese leadership, this session represents the fourth time the two presidents have met within a period of just over two years. The ongoing diplomatic engagement highlights the frequency of interactions between the two nations as they navigate their shared regional interests and bilateral ties.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent outlets, reflecting steady coverage of diplomatic developments between Indonesia and China.
